items.stem: Business logic must run inside the Dataverse transaction and roll back the operation if validation fails. Where should it be implemented?

options.text: A synchronous plug-in on the correct pipeline stage
options.rationale: Correct: a synchronous plug-in runs in the transaction and can throw to roll back.

options.text: A scheduled Power Automate cloud flow
options.rationale: A scheduled flow runs asynchronously and cannot roll back the originating transaction.
Canvas formulas run client-side and cannot enforce a server transaction.
Power BI measures are for reporting, not transactional validation.

The default solution is the environment's working container, not a transport artifact.
A publisher is required; this is not a promotion strategy.

items.stem: Which TWO options let an external system be notified when a Dataverse row changes? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: webhooks push Dataverse events to an external HTTP endpoint.

options.text: Register an Azure Service Bus endpoint
options.rationale: Correct: Service Bus endpoints relay Dataverse events for external consumers.
Business rules run inside the app; they do not notify external systems.
Dashboards visualize data; they do not emit change events.
Field requirement is validation, not eventing.
